newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangdong Inv 1996 net HK$604.29 mln.
newsitem.headline: Guangdong Inv 1996 net HK$604.29 mln.

text.p: NOTE - Guangdong Investment engages in investment holding, hotel ownership and management.
Total dividend for year is nine H.K.cents (including interim dividend of 3.8 cents) vs nine cents.
Net is after exceptional gain from dilution of shareholding in a subsidiary, interest income from a subsidiary's initial public offering, and disposal of a contractual joint venture.

The directors recommend a bonus issue of warrants on the basis of one warrant for every 10 shares held by shareholders on the register of members on June 25. Each warrant entitles the holder to subscribe for one share by July 30, 1999, or the preceding business day if July 30 is not a business day in Hong Kong, at a subscription price of HK$8 per share subject to adjustment.
